instructions: Use the final alternate strategy to make a single open gantry bay dominate the 64-inch gameplay view. Recess one shallow asymmetric sheet canopy behind the front crossbeam; keep only the two outer support posts at the loading face; make the blue and cream appliance panels oversized and unmistakable; suspend a pale timber block, plain rope, and hook in the empty center; and add a broad presentation-only plank route from the sill into the bay. Place useful storage at the sides. Use high-contrast color-blocked enamel repairs and readable sheet patches, remove dark banded/circular focal hardware, and preserve the 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope with no gameplay changes.
tool: Blender component authoring with broad geometry-built enamel repair plates and a recessed open-front gantry; PBR materials remain presentation-only.
post_processing: Validate the GLB in Godot against the exact 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope and verify PBR bindings.
Render close, 64-inch settlement, and 330-inch room views through the review-only Scavenger presentation registry.
Have Luna inspect actual Godot pixels against the approved concept and the current gameplay capture; retain the production registry until the candidate passes its gates.
material_method: Form-first material design: broad, geometry-built enamel repairs and high-contrast center walkway boards carry gameplay recognition, with tiled PBR patina reserved for close range; avoid brass, gears and banded cylinders.
